teaching_objective: Explain the concept of a Stop Loss visually.

slides.headline: Stop Loss: बड़े नुकसान से बचाव
slides.core_explanation: Stop Loss एक सुरक्षा जाल (safety net) की तरह है। यदि बाज़ार गिरता है, तो यह आपके नुकसान को एक तय सीमा पर रोक देता है।

visual_spec.visual_concept: A safety net catching a falling object before it hits the ground.
visual_spec.image_generation_prompt: NotebookLM-style educational aesthetic. Rich illustrated storytelling with scenes and visual metaphors. Full-width composition with substantial vertical depth (4:3 ratio). A conceptual scene showing a steep cliff or falling chart line. A glowing, sturdy high-tech safety net catches a falling glowing sphere (representing capital) safely before it hits the jagged rocks below. An investor stands safely on the cliff watching. Light, soft, airy pastel colors. CRITICAL: NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO NUMBERS, NO CHARACTERS OF ANY ALPHABET inside the image itself. The image must be completely text-free.
